intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Winston-Salem for 2026, and here is what he found: 33 family events across Winston-Salem and 3 nearby towns, 12 of them free. The magic runs from November 6 (THE POLAR EXPRESS Train Ride) through January 3, 2027 (Camel Train: A Pop-Up Holiday Extravaganza at MUSE), with the Winston-Salem Holiday Parade and Tree Lighting (December 5), Four Christmases at Bethabara (December 5) and Christmas for the City (December 19) and An Enchanted Christmas at Reynolda (December 12 and 15) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Winston Salem

  • 33 Christmas events for kids in Winston-Salem, Lewisville and King
  • 12 free events, including The Christmas Family Lights on Shiloh Church Road, Tuba Christmas, the Winston-Salem Holiday Parade and Tree Lighting, Four Christmases at Bethabara, Christmas for the City, the Lewisville Christmas Parade, Lewisville Holiday Movie Night with Elf and the King Christmas Parade
  • Meet Santa: Christmas for the City (December 19), Christmas Kick-Off at Old Salem (November 28) and St. Nick at Old Salem (December 5)
  • Holiday shows and house tours: An Enchanted Christmas at Reynolda (December 12 and 15), Joy of Christmas Evening Tours at Old Salem and Holiday Pops with Cirque de la Symphonie (November 28 and 29)
  • Parades and tree lightings: Winston-Salem Holiday Parade and Tree Lighting (December 5), King Christmas Parade (December 5) and Lewisville Christmas Parade (December 13)
  • Trains: Camel Train model trains at MUSE Winston-Salem (November 27 to January 3) and THE POLAR EXPRESS Train Ride in Spencer
  • Season: November 6 to January 3, 2027

Planning a bigger day out? Winston-Salem families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Greensboro, which covers Winter Wonderlights at the Greensboro Science Center and the downtown Festival of Lights.
